text:
maia: ran a focused tracefold sim on the prefetch/gating path this morning. saw a weird interaction between batch formation and KV warmup where small bursts starve the token budget
maia: reproducer: replayed 48h trace (prod-sampled) with gating-v2 enabled vs baseline for 1k users
maia: short summary: gating-v2 reduces average batch size by ~10% but improves p50 latency slightly; p95 regressed on long-tail requests that miss the KV cache
sam: can you paste the config you used? curious about `token_budget_target` and queue windows
jia: also curious which kernel variant got selected more often under gating-v2
maia: config snippet:```yaml
queue_policy: age_based
age_window_ms: 18
token_budget_target: 220
prefetch_lookahead: 64
kv_warmup: enabled
kv_warmup_threshold_ms: 12
```
noah: thanks — that token budget is lower than our default (300). may explain smaller batches. did you try 300/400?
maia: yes did a sweep 220/300/420. 300 matched baseline throughput with similar cost; 420 gave larger batches but caused more KV eviction churn in the sim
perf-bot: ab-harness run-id: af3e2c control=baseline gating-v2=enabled samples=20k
perf-bot: metrics: control p95=142ms, gating-v2 p95=158ms, control avg_batch=12.1, gating avg_batch=10.9, kv_miss_rate +3.4%
sam: ok that's a visible p95 regression. any idea why misses increased? pattern logs?
maia: digging into traces — missed warmups happen when a request arrives just after a prefetch window and before the next batch forms. gating reduces waiting so prefetches are less likely to have finished
jia: so gating trades KV hit-rate for lower median latency. could we add a short prefetch stall window for requests that look like likely-followups?
noah: maybe add `prefetch_grace_ms: 6` for sequences with low entropy (chatty callers). low-cost middle-ground
maia: tried `prefetch_grace_ms: 6` in sim: p95 improved to 146ms, avg_batch stayed ~11.0, kv_miss delta reduced to +1.0%
maia: logs (snippet):```
[replay] uid=4573 seq=12 action=prefetch start=160000 end=160006 hit=true
[replay] uid=4573 seq=13 action=batch_form size=9 kernel=A2
[replay] uid=8721 seq=1 action=prefetch start=160012 end=160018 hit=false
```
sam: looks promising. can we run a canary in staging with gating-v2 + prefetch_grace? small % of traffic
jia: +1. also add a short eval harness to compare generation quality and cost per token between variants
maia: will schedule a staging canary and push updated sim config to replay infra. I'll attach run artifacts here when ready :thumbsup:
